name: @openclaw/tsa-webhook-direct-delivery
description: TSA webhook direct-delivery zero-LLM (Hermes v0.11 pattern). Subscribes to OpenClaw diagnostic events and dispatches them straight to Telegram/HTTP webhooks without invoking the agent loop. Saves tokens by replacing bash hook curl spam (notify-stop.sh, integrity-check.sh) with config-driven, throttled, fan-out delivery.
